test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

He will give you / good advice if / you will ask him.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"you will ask him."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"you will ask him"** of the sentence.
 
• In this sentence, the use of **"will" **is not necessary after** "if" **because the verb **"ask"** already indicates a future action.
 
• The sentence is in the present simple tense, and the condition (asking for advice) is implied in the simple present tense after **"if."**
 
• Using **"will"** again in the second part of the sentence is incorrect.
 
• The correct sentence would be *"He will give you good advice if **you ask him**__."*
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
